description: (needs account token) Deletes a site, including its files and versions. Not reversible. A site with a domain registered here, or with email still on, is refused until those are settled. A suspended site is refused. confirm=true applies it. Does not charge.

confirm.description: True applies the change. False leaves it unchanged and the reply describes what would change.

site.description: The address of the site to delete, for example myproject.dropthehassle.app.

name: delete_site
title: Delete site
